title: National Geographic double-blind remote viewing of the Dumbarton Bridge

tellings.quote: the end of the dumb Barton Bridge

plain: In a double-blind test filmed by National Geographic, set up so that neither the viewer nor the people with him knew the target, Joe McMoneagle says he described a hidden location by remote viewing, the claimed skill of sensing a distant place with the mind alone. He tells Michels he took part himself, that a man he calls Ed was involved, and that the target turned out to be 'the end of the Dumbarton Bridge' in the San Francisco Bay Area. If true, it would be a controlled result in favour of remote viewing.
